name: LED wall
description: An image on a stadium LED board: round diodes on a black grid with stepped brightness, soft bloom, sun louvres, the odd dead diode and a rolling scan band.

name: Subpixel zoom
description: A macro zoom in and out of a screen: the picture breaks into its pixels and then into glowing red, green and blue subpixels, as LCD stripes, PenTile diamonds or CRT phosphor triads.

controls.l: Layout (0 LCD stripes, 1 PenTile, 2 CRT triads)

name: Brick mosaic
description: An image rebuilt from toy bricks with studs, ironed fuse beads or cross-stitch on cloth, in a few flat colours, built up row by row from the bottom.

name: Pixel sprites
description: A field of little procedurally generated pixel creatures, each mirror-symmetric with an outline and blinking eyes, bobbing in place and swapping for new ones now and then.

name: Pixel city
description: A night-time pixel skyline in parallax: three rows of towers with windows flicking on and off, blinking aerials, stars, a crescent moon and car lights along the street.

name: RPG dialog
description: A role-playing game's text box: a pixel-bordered panel with a speaker's name tab slides up, the line types out letter by letter in a pixel font, and a continue arrow blinks.

controls.d: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

texts.name: text
texts.label: Text
texts.default: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

name: LED ticker
description: A dot-matrix LED sign with any text marching across it a column at a time, its lit dots glowing over the dim unlit ones, in a seamless loop.

name: Pixel explosion
description: An 8-bit explosion: a white-hot pixel fireball swelling through yellow, orange and red into a ring of smoke, sparks flying out, frame by frame.

name: Deep fried
description: A picture fried to a crisp: saturation and contrast blown out, posterised colour, oversharpened halos, JPEG blocking and grain, with red glints flaring from two points such as the eyes.

name: Dramatic zoom
description: A crash zoom onto a point (a face, a stare, a detail) in a few sudden steps, each landing with a kick while a vignette closes in, then a hold and a snap back to the whole picture.

name: Laser eyes
description: Laser beams firing from two eyes over a picture: a white-hot core in a red glow, flaring at each eye and flickering, aimed at any angle and spread, with the picture darkened behind them.

name: To be continued
description: A picture that freezes on a sudden sepia grade with a little punch-in, then a left-pointing arrow slides in at the bottom with its words on it, holds, and it starts over.

name: Needs more JPEG
description: A picture saved again and again at lower quality: 8 × 8 blocks, smeared blocky colour and mosquito noise around its edges grow with each step down, then it snaps back clean and starts over.

name: Triggered
description: A picture tinted red and jittering fast in place, with a banner bar along the bottom carrying its word; the jitter is capped and nothing flashes.

name: Vaporwave grade
description: A picture regraded pink and cyan, with soft scanlines and a split of its colours, a striped sun setting over a moving grid in the lower third, and a strip of glyphs along the top.

name: Galaxy brain
description: Cosmic light radiating from a head that climbs through four levels of enlightenment: a soft halo, then rays, then a nebula full of stars, then a starburst over the whole picture, before it settles and starts again.

name: Sad mode
description: A picture drained to a cool blue-grey with rain streaking down over it, the camera slowly pulling back and a heavy vignette closing in.

name: Game over banner
description: A picture that slows to stuttering frames and drains to grey, then a dark band fades in across it with big serif words on it, growing a little as it holds, before it starts over.

name: Impact caption
description: The classic meme caption: white Impact capitals with a heavy black outline across the top and bottom of the frame, each fitted to the width, popping on with the punchline a beat after the setup.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: Deal with it
description: Pixel sunglasses sliding slowly down from the top of the frame onto a pair of eyes, landing with a little bounce, then a caption snapping on underneath.
